# KRISHIGEARS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED — B2B Farm Machinery & Genuine Spare Parts

> Registered Office: Flat No.: T5-202, Mahima Shubh Nilay Apartments, Jaisinghpura, Ajmer Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302026. CIN: U46539RJ2026PTC117758 | GSTIN: 08AANCK2216L1ZA | PAN: AANCK2216L | TAN: JPRK10437A.

KrishiGears manufactures, distributes, and wholesales commercial farm machinery across all 740 Indian districts. All machines are tested to FMTTI / SRFMTTI standards. Direct factory dispatch with GST billing.

## Core Products & Specifications
- [KG-170F Petrol Power Weeder (7 HP / 212cc)](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): 4-stroke petrol engine, 3600 RPM, recoil start, 32 dryland rotary blades, PTO shaft for water pump and reaper attachments.
- [KG-173F Diesel Power Weeder (5.5 HP)](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): 4-stroke direct injection diesel engine, high low-RPM torque for deep clay plowing.
- [KG-177F WOLF Petrol Weeder (9 HP / 270cc)](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): Direct-drive gear transmission, replacement for mini-tractors in sugarcane and orchards.
- [KG-ICP-P170-LDE Electric Start Weeder (7 HP)](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): Key ignition self-start with backup recoil, dual LED headlights.
- [KG-ICP-UP170-SH Back-Rotary Weeder (7 HP)](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): Active counter-rotating rear tines reducing operator fatigue by 50%.
- [KG-ICD-UP186-SH Heavy Diesel Weeder (10 HP)](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): Dual PTO shaft, commercial contract farming and custom hiring centers.
- [KG Baby Weeder](https://krishigears.com/products/category/power-weeders): Ultra-lightweight inter-cultivator for paddy wetlands and greenhouse vegetables.
- [Genuine OEM Spare Parts (19 Categories)](https://krishigears.com/spare-parts): Forged crankshafts, piston assemblies, precision float carburetors, recoil starters, gearbox oil seals, rotavator blades.
